tools.name: lookup_hts_code
tools.description: US tariff lookup for one HTS code (4, 6, 8 or 10 digits): description, general/special/column 2 duty rates, Section 301 China list status with the additional rate, exclusions, and the 2026 US–China reduction flag.

tools.name: search_hts
tools.description: Find US HTS codes from product words (e.g. "air fryer", "wooden toys") or a code prefix. Returns codes with description, general rate and Section 301 China summary.

tools.name: section301_lists
tools.description: All Section 301 China tariff headings (lists 1, 2, 3, 4A, 4B, 2024 increases, exclusions) with rates, dates and code counts.

tools.name: china_deal_status
tools.description: Status of the 2026 US–China tariff reduction list (pending / notice_published / published) and, with code, whether that HTS code is on it.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "lookup_hts_code" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "china_deal_status" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
